race.comment: CATTLE CAMP (5) looks a progressive type who resumes after a break. Did win at his only other first-up run when on debut, scoring over 1006m at Sale. Beaten less than a length in town at only other start and has trialled well this time. Gets a gun draw too. MAUNA KEA MISS (11) missed the frame but not disgraced in town when sixth at Caulfield. Returns to home track this time. The winkers are removed now and looks a top chance in this, which is a step down on her recent assignments. INSAIN HARRY (1) was a late scratching at Geelong last week in a race in which he was very well-backed, so there's a bit of expectation that he's come back well. GLENFINNIAN (4) has run some nice races in much tougher events than this. Been a while since we've seen his best, but looks the right race for him to show it. Giga Kick's half-brother PANTOJA (8) disappointed last start, but was a nice winner the start prior and can play a role with a repeat of that effort.
